name: Space Warping (Log+Warp)
definition: Warps 3D space towards the view cell center using radial distortion to bring background closer for positional encoding, dampening high frequencies in the background while preserving foreground detail.
summary: Space Warping (Log+Warp) is a coordinate transformation technique that improves neural volume rendering efficiency by using radial distortion to compress background depth, distinguishing itself from NDC Warping by supporting general forward-facing scenes.
